reason: positive side failed on config_renamed seed 12: the preconditions do not hold on the state the program is meant to fix, so it could never fire there (ignored_file_has_stale_key: exit=1 (expected 0); stdout='' stderr='')

refused_program.body:
# Find the renames mapping file in the upstream branch
renames_path=""
while IFS= read -r f; do
  if git show "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*[^#[:space:]]+[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]*$'; then
    renames_path="$f"
    break
  fi
done < <(git ls-tree -r -z --name-only {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -i 'rename')
[ -n "$renames_path" ] || exit 0

mapping_file=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$mapping_file"' EXIT
git show "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$renames_path" | awk '
  /^[[:space:]]*[^#]/ {
    eq = index($0, "=")
    if (eq == 0) next
    old = substr($0, 1, eq-1)
    new = substr($0, eq+1)
    gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", old)
    gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", new)
    if (old != "" && new != "") print old "\t" new
  }
' > "$mapping_file"
[ -s "$mapping_file" ] || exit 0

while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  awk -v mapfile="$mapping_file" '
    BEGIN {
      while ((getline line < mapfile) > 0) {
        split(line, a, "\t")
        old[a[1]] = a[2]
      }
    }
    {
      if (match($0, /^[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]*=/)) {
        orig_len = RLENGTH
        prefix = substr($0, 1, orig_len)
        match(prefix, /^[[:space:]]*/)
        leading = substr(prefix, 1, RLENGTH)
        rest = substr(prefix, RLENGTH+1)
        match(rest, /^[^[:space:]]+/)
        key = substr(rest, 1, RLENGTH)
        if (key in old) {
          rest = old[key] substr(rest, RLENGTH+1)
          print leading rest substr($0, orig_len+1)
          next
        }
      }
      print
    }
  ' "$file" > "$tmp"
  if cmp -s "$file" "$tmp"; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
  else
    cat "$tmp" > "$file"
    rm -f "$tmp"
  fi
done < <(git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z)
